question: Recall that for a complex number \(z=x+iy\), where \(i=\sqrt{-1}\), \(\bar z=x-iy\) and \(|z|=(x^2+y^2)^{1/2}\). The set of all pairs of complex numbers \((z_1,z_2)\) which satisfy \(\left|\frac{z_1-z_2}{1-\bar z_1z_2}\right|<1\) is

options.A: all possible pairs \((z_1,z_2)\) of complex numbers
options.B: all pairs of complex numbers \((z_1,z_2)\) for which \(|z_1|<1\) and \(|z_2|<1\)
options.C: all pairs of complex numbers \((z_1,z_2)\) for which at least one of the following statements is true: (i) \(|z_1|<1\) and \(|z_2|>1\); (ii) \(|z_1|>1\) and \(|z_2|<1\)
options.D: all pairs of complex numbers \((z_1,z_2)\) for which at least one of the following statements is true: (i) \(|z_1|<1\) and \(|z_2|<1\); (ii) \(|z_1|>1\) and \(|z_2|>1\)
